parameters.name: ComponentId
parameters.description: The Dataset Accelerator component ID. To obtain the component ID, call [ListComponents](~~467918~~).

parameters.name: RenderTemplate
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to render and display the component template.
If the value is true, the response includes the rendered template content.
> Only the following components are supported:
  dataset-accelerator
The maximum length of the returned component template content is 4096 bytes. Content that exceeds the maximum length is truncated.
>

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: The parameters used for rendering the component template.
